findings.highlight: to drink coffee with plenty of sugar and milk
findings.evidenceJa: それを砂糖とミルクたっぷりのコーヒーで流し込む
findings.explanation: The Touma household habit was to wash the entire spread of sweets down with heavily sweetened, milky coffee. The translation mentions only drinking the coffee and drops the excess dessert consumption it accompanies.
findings.japanese:
「それを砂糖とミルクたっぷりのコーヒーで流し込むのが
子供の頃のウチの習慣で…」
findings.todokanai: "It was our habit back when I was a kid to drink coffee with plenty of sugar and milk…"

findings.highlight: That's how much strength and willpower she must've had
findings.evidenceJa: それだけ体力と精神力を使ってたんだろうな
findings.explanation: Kazusa supposes Youko must have expended that much physical and mental energy, explaining the calories. The translation says the feat proves how much strength and willpower she possessed, reversing consumption into capacity.
findings.japanese:
「あの人はそれをこともなげに平らげてた。
…それだけ体力と精神力を使ってたんだろうな」
findings.todokanai: "She was able to eat it all without a care… That's how much strength and willpower she must've had."

findings.highlight: The cake-addicted pianist
findings.evidenceJa: ケーキをぱくつくピアニスト
findings.explanation: Haruki suggests the image or headline 'a pianist gobbling cake.' The translation diagnoses addiction, escalating a visual human-interest detail into a dependency claim.
findings.japanese: 「ケーキをぱくつくピアニスト？」
findings.todokanai: "The cake-addicted pianist?"

findings.highlight: Despite the sound of the shutter, Kazusa still puts the fork in her mouth, softly forgiving me
findings.evidenceJa: 突然のフラッシュにもかかわらず、かずさはフォークを口に入れたまま、ちょっと照れただけで俺を許してくれた
findings.explanation: The flash interrupts Kazusa while the fork is already in her mouth; Haruki interprets her mere embarrassment as forgiveness. The translation substitutes shutter sound, makes her put the fork in afterward, and narrates forgiveness as an observable action rather than his reading.
findings.japanese:
突然のフラッシュにもかかわらず、
かずさはフォークを口に入れたまま、
ちょっと照れただけで俺を許してくれた。
findings.todokanai: Despite the sound of the shutter, Kazusa still puts the fork in her mouth, softly forgiving me with an embarrassed look.

findings.highlight: made the usual breakfast, I went over to Kazusa's apartment
findings.evidenceJa: 隣に朝食を作りに行ったら、かずさは昨日届いたベッドと見事に一体化していた
findings.explanation: Haruki goes next door to make breakfast and discovers Kazusa fused with the bed. The translation has him make breakfast first and only then go to her apartment, relocating the cooking and reversing the discovery sequence.
findings.japanese:
いつもの時間に起床した俺が、
そのままの勢いで隣に朝食を作りに行ったら、
かずさは昨日届いたベッドと見事に一体化していた…
findings.todokanai: After I had woken up at my usual time and made the usual breakfast, I went over to Kazusa's apartment only to see her spectacularly glued to the bed…

findings.highlight: inside a metropolis
findings.evidenceJa: 都内にしては綺麗な川
findings.explanation: The river is unusually clean specifically for one within Tokyo. 'A metropolis' removes the established city and turns the comparison generic.
findings.japanese:
都内にしては綺麗な川が流れ、草木も多く、
だからこそ、寒さも余計身に染みて…
findings.todokanai: The river is beautiful for being something inside a metropolis. There's even a lot of vegetation. That's precisely why the cold permeates this area that much more…

findings.highlight: any place that has a history with me
findings.evidenceJa: 昔のあたしを知っている場所
findings.explanation: Kazusa reverses the prior grammar: first places her old self knew, then places that know and can bear witness to her old self. 'Has a history with me' flattens that deliberate personification and parallel inversion.
findings.japanese:
『昔のあたしが知っている場所には…
昔のあたしを知っている場所には、近づかない』
findings.todokanai: "I won't ever come near any place that I used to know… or any place that has a history with me."

findings.highlight: I'm so indecisive
findings.evidenceJa: なんて朝令暮改
findings.explanation: Kazusa condemns herself with 朝令暮改, changing an order by evening after issuing it in the morning—fickle inconsistency and immediate reversal. 'Indecisive' instead suggests failure to decide at all.
findings.japanese:
「なんて意志薄弱。
なんて朝令暮改。
あたしって、馬鹿じゃないのか…」
findings.todokanai: "I'm so weak-willed. I'm so indecisive. Am I an idiot or something…?"

findings.highlight: colored paper
findings.evidenceJa: 勝手に色紙を預かってくる
findings.explanation: The objects are shikishi autograph boards collected for Kazusa's signature, not ordinary sheets of colored paper. The same mistranslation obscures why they later form a valuable stack.
findings.japanese:
「そんなの知るか！
勝手に色紙を預かってくるなんて
どういうつもりだ！？」
findings.todokanai: "I don't give a crap about that! You say they gave you colored paper for me to sign without asking for permission!?"

findings.highlight: while compiling the work sent to me as miscellaneous work
findings.evidenceJa: 在宅勤務中に受けた仕事について、各所を回って打ち合わせをしているうちに
findings.explanation: Haruki spends the day visiting various parties for meetings about assignments received during remote work. The translation turns that field coordination into compiling miscellaneous work and loses how the autograph requests accumulated.
findings.japanese:
その後、在宅勤務中に受けた仕事について、
各所を回って打ち合わせをしているうちに、
何故か手元に色紙が山積みになっていた。
findings.todokanai: After that, while compiling the work sent to me as miscellaneous work, for some reason there was a mountain of colored paper in front of me.

findings.highlight: "Then what is it? There is no more dessert. You need to worry about your nutritional balance after eating…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「じゃあなんだよ？
デザートの追加はなしだぞ。
俺の飯を食うからには栄養バランスを…」
findings.explanation: after eating — Haruki says that so long as Kazusa eats his cooking, he controls its nutritional balance. 'After' makes the concern merely temporal.
findings.japanese:
「じゃあなんだよ？
デザートの追加はなしだぞ。
俺の飯を食うからには栄養バランスを…」
findings.todokanai: "Then what is it? There is no more dessert. You need to worry about your nutritional balance after eating…"

findings.highlight: Little by little, Kazusa crosses over the line
findings.evidenceJa: とうとう、かずさが踏み込んだ
findings.explanation: Kazusa finally steps into the avoided topic in a decisive moment. The translation makes the crossing gradual and ongoing.
findings.japanese: とうとう、かずさが踏み込んだ。
findings.todokanai: Little by little, Kazusa crosses over the line.

findings.highlight: Tell me that you're sick of me
findings.evidenceJa: だったらのろけてみせろよ？あたしに『やってられるか』って言わせてみろよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa challenges Haruki to gush about Setsuna until Kazusa herself says she cannot stand listening. The translation makes Haruki tell Kazusa that he is sick of her, reversing speaker, object, and the relationship being discussed.
findings.japanese:
「だったらのろけてみせろよ？
あたしに『やってられるか』って言わせてみろよ」
findings.todokanai: "Then go ahead and tell me. Tell me that you're sick of me."

findings.highlight: which reason is the true one
findings.evidenceJa: どんな理由も本当なんだ
findings.explanation: Haruki understands that every offered reason is a pretext and, simultaneously, every one expresses part of Kazusa's truth. The translation turns that coexistence into selecting which single reason is true.
findings.japanese:
もとからどんな理由だって嘘だって。
そして、どんな理由も本当なんだって。
findings.todokanai: That all her reasons were lies to begin with, and which reason is the true one.

findings.highlight: memorized my methods of interviewing
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の取材道具の使い方を覚えてしまっていた
findings.explanation: Kazusa has learned how to operate Haruki's interview equipment, enabling her to stop recordings, delete images, and turn the recorder on him. The translation changes concrete device literacy into abstract interviewing method.
findings.japanese:
ここ数日の取材攻勢で、かずさはすっかり
俺の取材道具の使い方を覚えてしまっていた。
findings.todokanai: After these past days of aggressive interviewing from me, Kazusa has completely memorized my methods of interviewing.

findings.highlight: our job hunting
findings.evidenceJa: お互いの卒業とか、就職とか
findings.explanation: Haruki lists their graduations and starting employment during the first year. The translation moves them backward to job hunting.
findings.japanese:
「一年目はお互いの卒業とか、就職とか。
友達のこととか家族のこととか雪菜の歌のこととか…」
findings.todokanai: "The first year was about our graduation, our job hunting, our friends, our family, and Setsuna's singing…"

findings.highlight: both Kazusa and Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜とかずさを『平等にひいき』してた
findings.explanation: Haruki's quoted paradox is that he favored both girls equally. The translation keeps special treatment but drops equality, the element that makes the earlier innocent balance possible.
findings.japanese:
怖いもの知らずだった。
雪菜とかずさを『平等にひいき』してた。
findings.todokanai: I was reckless. I was giving both Kazusa and Setsuna "special treatment."

findings.highlight: We two cannot be allowed to like each other
findings.evidenceJa: 二人のことを好きでいることは許されない
findings.explanation: Haruki says he is no longer permitted to love both Setsuna and Kazusa. The translation instead says Haruki and one other person are forbidden to like each other, replacing a triangular moral problem with reciprocal prohibition.
findings.japanese: 二人のことを好きでいることは許されない。
findings.todokanai: We two cannot be allowed to like each other.

findings.highlight: she has been on stage countless times
findings.evidenceJa: 何度かステージに上がってた
findings.explanation: Setsuna appeared onstage several times after the Valentine's live. 'Countless' radically inflates a limited number central to the five-year summary.
findings.japanese:
就職してからはずっとご無沙汰だったけど、
あのバレンタインライブ以降、
何度かステージに上がってた。
findings.todokanai: She has been on a hiatus ever since she got employed, but ever since that Valentine's Day concert, she has been on stage countless times.

findings.highlight: due to my poor conversational abilities, and my unstable feelings
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の話術の未熟さか、俺の気持ちの不安定さか
findings.explanation: Haruki cannot tell whether his concealment fails because his speaking technique is immature or because his feelings are unstable. The translation makes both definite cumulative causes.
findings.japanese:
隠そうとしても、結局そこに行き着いてしまうのは、
俺の話術の未熟さか、俺の気持ちの不安定さか。
findings.todokanai: Even when I tried to hide it, this is the destination I've arrived at due to my poor conversational abilities, and my unstable feelings.

findings.highlight: ten whole days
findings.evidenceJa: 十数日も会っていない
findings.explanation: Haruki and Setsuna have not met for more than ten days—some number in the teens. The translation fixes it at exactly ten.
findings.japanese:
もう、十数日も会っていないこと。
声すら、聞けていないこと。
findings.todokanai: Now we haven't met for ten whole days. I haven't even heard her voice.

findings.highlight: But of course I can't tell her that
findings.evidenceJa: なんて、言うわけないだろ
findings.explanation: The rejected utterance is Haruki's preceding internal admission that he could not leave Kazusa suffering and wanted to help her, not the reassurance about feelings he has just spoken aloud. The English attaches 'that' to the voiced reassurance and creates an immediate contradiction.
findings.japanese: なんて、言うわけないだろ。
findings.todokanai: But of course I can't tell her that.

findings.highlight: perhaps I'll be able to return in my second year
findings.evidenceJa: さすがに二年目にもなったら、少しは余裕が
findings.explanation: Setsuna thought that by her second year as an employee she might gain a little breathing room, then jokes that work may instead grow busier. The translation says she hoped she could return, changing the expected resource from spare capacity to a comeback.
findings.japanese:
「でも、さすがに二年目にもなったら、
少しは余裕が…なんて、
かえって忙しくなりそうな気配がアリアリですけど」
findings.todokanai: "But I thought that perhaps I'll be able to return in my second year… or so I hoped. It actually looks like I'm only going to get more busy from now on."

findings.highlight: one of those famous industry people
findings.evidenceJa: 噂を聞きつけた業界の人
findings.explanation: They speculate that the disguised woman may be an industry person who heard the buzz about Setsuna. The translation makes the industry person herself famous.
findings.japanese:
「なるほど、そういう考え方もあるのか…
てことは噂を聞きつけた業界の人かなぁ？」
findings.todokanai: "I see, that's one way of looking at it… Does that mean she's one of those famous industry people?"

findings.highlight: that's how much ability Setsuna has
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜にはそれだけの華がある
findings.explanation: Tomo argues that Setsuna has star presence or glamour warranting discovery. Generic ability removes the public charisma under discussion and makes the next line about ambition less coherent.
findings.japanese:
「だって雪菜にはそれだけの華があるんだもん。
眠らせておくのもったいないって！」
findings.todokanai: "But that's how much ability Setsuna has. It's a crime to let her talent go to waste!"

findings.highlight: Setsuna was there
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜だった
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the performer truly was the Setsuna she knew—recognition of enduring Setsuna-ness, not merely confirmation that Setsuna was physically present. The translation reduces the emotional identification to attendance.
findings.japanese: 「雪菜だった…」
findings.todokanai: "Setsuna was there…"

findings.highlight: the concert hall
findings.evidenceJa: ライブハウスに赴いた
findings.explanation: Kazusa goes to a live house, the small club venue central to Routes and Setsuna's scene. 'Concert hall' implies a larger, formal performance space.
findings.japanese:
そう言って、
いつもの変装でライブハウスに赴いたかずさは…
findings.todokanai: With those words, Kazusa went toward the concert hall with her usual disguise…

findings.highlight: we couldn't become friends
findings.evidenceJa: 親友にはなれなかった
findings.explanation: Kazusa says they failed to become best friends, recalling the earlier extreme of lifelong best friendship. The translation lowers the failed possibility to ordinary friendship.
findings.japanese:
「結局、親友にはなれなかったけど…
そうしてしまったのはあたしだけど」
findings.todokanai: "In the end, we couldn't become friends… but that was my fault."

findings.highlight: a bitter, resigned breakdown in resolve
findings.evidenceJa: 諦めにも似た決裂
findings.explanation: The narration calls this a rupture or break resembling resignation, contrasting the former agreement. The translation says Kazusa's resolve breaks down, when the resolve to avoid becoming Setsuna's enemy is precisely what she has reached.
findings.japanese:
あの時の、苦笑混じりの合意とは違う、
ただ苦いだけの、諦めにも似た決裂。
findings.todokanai: Unlike her bitter smile of agreement back then, she shows nothing but a bitter, resigned breakdown in resolve.

findings.highlight: I think that Setsuna… still thinks of you as a friend
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜は…今でもかずさのこと、親友だと思ってる
findings.explanation: Haruki asserts that Setsuna still regards Kazusa as her best friend. The translation both hedges the statement with 'I think' and downgrades best friend to friend.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜は…
今でもかずさのこと、親友だと思ってる」
findings.todokanai: "I think that Setsuna… still thinks of you as a friend, Kazusa."

findings.highlight: So you can remain employed
findings.evidenceJa: 春希は社会人であるために、開桜社の編集部の北原社員であるために
findings.explanation: Kazusa builds a normative role argument: as a working adult and Kaiousha editorial employee, Haruki cannot disclose a subject's privacy. The translation invents a threat that disclosure would cost his employment.
findings.japanese:
「だから、春希は社会人であるために、
開桜社の編集部の北原社員であるために、
雪菜にあたしのことを言うことができないんだ」
findings.todokanai: "So you can remain employed, Haruki; so you can remain as Mr. Kitahara of the editing department of Kaiousha, you can't tell Setsuna anything about me."

findings.highlight: when I try to sound smart
findings.evidenceJa: 理論武装したときの俺そのもの
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes Kazusa as himself when armored in logic—using airtight reasoning to defend an emotionally unacceptable act. 'Try to sound smart' reduces the shared defense mechanism to intellectual vanity.
findings.japanese: 今のお前は、理論武装したときの俺そのものだ。
findings.todokanai: Right now, you're just like me when I try to sound smart.

findings.highlight: how the opponent feels when they use it
findings.evidenceJa: その戦法を使ったときの、敵の心情
findings.explanation: Haruki knows how his opponent feels when he himself uses this argumentative strategy against them. The translation says the opponent is the one employing the strategy, reversing the combat roles.
findings.japanese:
だから俺は、その戦法の弱点を知っている。
その戦法を使ったときの、敵の心情を知っている。
findings.todokanai: That's why I know the weakness of that strategy. I know how the opponent feels when they use it.

findings.highlight: trembles in fear on my chest
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の胸の中でむずがってみせる
findings.explanation: Kazusa fusses, squirms, or protests restlessly in Haruki's arms after explicitly saying no. The translation invents fear as her emotional state, which the source does not establish.
findings.japanese: かずさが、俺の胸の中でむずがってみせる。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa trembles in fear on my chest.

findings.highlight: Is everyone outside now?
findings.evidenceJa: みんなもう外に出てるよ？
findings.explanation: Tomo tells Setsuna that everyone is already outside, using a prompting final particle. The translation makes Tomo ask Setsuna for information she has come to provide.
findings.japanese: 「みんなもう外に出てるよ？」
findings.todokanai: "Is everyone outside now?"

findings.highlight: found my determination to meet him
findings.evidenceJa: やっとぶつかってみる決心がついた
findings.explanation: Setsuna resolves to try confronting or colliding with Haruki directly after remembering everything. 'Meet him' removes the difficult conflict that her planned tears and mutual forgiveness are meant to initiate.
findings.japanese:
「ステージに立って、何もかも忘れて思いっきり歌って、
ステージから降りて何もかも思い出したら、
やっとぶつかってみる決心がついた」
findings.todokanai: "When I stood on the stage singing my heart out, I forgot about everything. When I got off the stage, I remembered everything and found my determination to meet him."
